info.name: Vaccinations
info.summary: Track vaccinations of your Nextcloud users and check them against a vaccination schedule
info.description:
Record vaccinations (date, vaccine, optional practice) for every user and check them against a selectable vaccination schedule (initially the German STIKO schedule). Shows overdue and upcoming vaccinations.
The vaccine-to-disease mapping is maintained as open data in the repository and can be extended via pull request.
info.author: Frank
